## [I love the selection of beautiful…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/61aba5732b49257fe2951d3c)
I love the selection of beautiful household decorations. I’ve been delighted with the two area rugs I have bought from Lulu and Georgia. I have some furniture, rugs, and gifts on order waiting to receive. 

The only reason why I am giving a 4 and not a five is for two reasons. One the shipping g charges are astronomical which makes it even hard to afford items when they are on sale because the discount actually goes to the shipping. 

Secondly, I think being able to talk to a human voice for customer service makes me feel better. Just that personal touch will go a long way! That being said I do get an email back when I do have a question or a concern. However I would love to talk to a designer or representative about your products and design. 

All in all you carry beautiful original things you won’t see everyone have. That makes your company unique. 😍

Thanks,

December 4, 2021
